thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Canary errors detected for SequoiaPay (dedicated VPC) - 7% 5xx on canary group A. Autoscaler healthy but latencies spiking. Root ts=1919504321

ashley: I'm on call. Paging eng-runtime + eng-sre. @devon @samir please take a look, SequoiaPay is in dedicated pool 42 and canary traffic is 2% of prod but errors are consistent.

devon: I see the alerts. Pulling canary logs now. Any quick mitigations recommended?

samir: If this is causing customer impact we should pin back to the previous artifact and isolate SequoiaPay's tenants to the fallback pool. Can you confirm customer-visible errors? @maria (AM)

maria: SequoiaPay reports intermittent transaction failures from their QA environment hitting our canary endpoint. Customer-facing systems intermittently get 502s, elevated latencies. They're asking for an immediate rollback.

ashley: Ok plan: 1) Pin artifact for SequoiaPay tenant to previous image id 2026-rc-238 (non-canary) 2) Abort canary rollouts for dedicated pool 42 3) Quarantine canary group A from global routing 4) Notify customer ops and schedule short maintenance window. Agree? :thumbsup:

leo: I'll handle the pool routing and quarantine. Initiating tenant isolation and routing pin now. Command I'm running:```sh
# isolate tenant SequoiaPay to reserved fallback nodes
redwoodctl routing set --tenant sequoiapay --pool reserved-fallback-42 --mode force
# pin artifact to previous
redwoodctl artifact pin --tenant sequoiapay --artifact 2026-rc-238
```

devon: I have logs showing a new kernel-selection path causing occasional memory pressure in the canary variant. Will roll back the model-serving kernel change in the canary, but since customer impacted, we should pin the artifact as Leo is doing.

samir: I'm attaching the canary probe output (excerpt):```text
[2026-06-11T15:12:03Z] canary-A request id=abc123 status=502 trace=oom kernel_select=optimized_v2 mem_usage=84%
[2026-06-11T15:12:07Z] canary-A request id=def456 status=200 lat_ms=1200 kernel_select=optimized_v2 mem_usage=67%``` That pattern matches a regression introduced by optimized_v2 kernel.

ashley: Good catch. Devon, can you revert kernel selection for canary group A back to optimized_v1 for now? If not immediate, pinning artifact will still mitigate.

devon: Reverting kernel selection on canary A now. Command:```sh
redwoodctl rollout kernel --pool canary-A --kernel optimized_v1 --sync
``` ETA ~ 45s.

oncall-2: Handoff: @ashley I'm taking over as primary oncall in 20m. Prep any outstanding actions to avoid duplicate work.

ashley: Thanks. Outstanding: confirm that pin succeeded, confirm routing quarantine is complete, confirm customer notifications sent. I'll leave notes here before handoff.

leo: Pin command returned success: "artifact 2026-rc-238 pinned for sequoiapay (scope: tenant)". Routing command returned 200 and no error: canary-A removed from global traffic.

devon: Kernel revert completed on canary-A. Monitoring logs now for 10 minutes to ensure no regression.

samir: Verified probes: error rate for canary-A down from 7% -> 0.5% over last 120s. Memory pressure dropped.

maria: I've messaged SequoiaPay ops: short maintenance window in progress, we've pinned your tenant to the previous stable artifact and isolated your traffic while we stabilize canary. Will follow up with timeline for full rollout reattempt. Customer replied: "Thanks, please keep us updated."

ashley: Great. Marking immediate mitigation successful. Next steps: 1) eng-runtime to prepare fix for kernel-selection regression (devon) 2) eng-sre to draft postmortem and impact assessment (samir) 3) CS to coordinate customer follow-up (maria) 4) Verify canary rollout after fix in a new controlled canary with expanded metrics.

oncall-2: Taking over. I'm documenting handoff: mitigation completed, artifact pinned, routing quarantined, kernel reverted. I'll monitor for next 2 hours and escalate if error rate creeps above 1%.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated (rollback/pin + config revert). SEV2 -> Monitoring. Incident ID INC-2026-0623-17. Root ts=1919504321 last_update=1919507921

ashley: Adding one-off note: we should add a preflight check to canary kernel selection that validates memory tail risk for optimized_v2 under our typical payload. Filing task in eng-runtime backlog.

samir: I'll start the postmortem doc and put initial impact numbers: 7% 5xx on canary group for ~12 minutes, ~30 failed transactions from SequoiaPay QA. Will schedule blameless review.

maria: I'll follow up with account and legal for customer communications template.

devon: I'll open a PR reverting the kernel auto-select and add the preflight test. Link once ready.

oncall-2: Monitoring continues. If anything new shows up, ping me directly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
